# Low-Priority Jules Lanes

These Jules tasks are intentionally small and non-blocking. They must not delay state, matching, export, privacy, responsive, integration, or release work.

- `JULES-T1`: notification-bell accessibility and server-confirmed read state.
- `JULES-U1`: collapsible-panel accessibility regression coverage.
- `JULES-S2`: secure-upload stale-error clearing and focused regression coverage.

Each task owns one production component at most and one focused test file. The assigned GitHub Issue is the exact authority.
